_doc: Acceptance rules fixed BEFORE looking at results (copied into each case by `new`; edit there, not after seeing outputs). "cell" gates every generated view (grid cell after `generate`, and the frozen image in `targets`); "refine" decides whether a refined view replaces its cell; "resync" decides whether a render-then-refine round is kept. Pixel thresholds are stated at 1664 px and scaled to the case's calibration width.

cell._doc: experiment: usable cells had object IoU 0.83-0.97; IoU below ~0.6, no reliably segmented object, or a panel that matches ANOTHER view's clay (duplicate / swapped panel) was a failure; a global offset of the content vs its clay above max_offset_frac of the width (edge phase correlation) also fails, because masks are only searched in a narrow band around the clay outline
